rationale: fastdiff_flow_pixel_unconstrained-claude-agentic: image_size=512, pixel_spacing=0.3516, n_angles=128, n_det=1024, det_spacing=0.35754, sod=500.0, sdd=1000.0, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.5, train_n=400, val_n=200, noise_i0=100000.0, noise_sigma_e=10.0, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_pixel_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.4, fd_recon_eta=0.05, fd_recon_dc=0, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, rationale=iter-7: DC-off breast-prior. Fix init_t=0.4. ONE KNOB eta 0.2->0.05. MONOTONIC eta trend (init_t0.4): eta1.0 PSNR24.6, eta0.5 PSNR27.0, eta0.2 PSNR28.1 (best) - lower eta = better because less overshooting measurement pull, recon converges to the prior-denoised FBP init. HYPOTHESIS: eta=0.05 (near-zero guidance) approaches pure prior-denoise of the FBP init -> PSNR edges further toward baseline, locating the eta floor. Since removing measurement guidance ENTIRELY would make it pure unconditional generation from FBP-noised init, a tiny eta is the DC-free sweet spot: it keeps a whisper of sinogram consistency without the overshoot instability. Then switch lever to steps.
